sources.locator: Kumoricon 2026 Full Schedule, Friday November 13 through Sunday November 15; each session locator gives its day, time, title and location.
Individual VTuber profiles, BEASTIEZ roster and Stellar Verse Productions
First attached image: SVP Meet & Greet, Friday, Booth 507, Exhibitor Hall; Chio through Rina
Second attached image: Saturday, Miwabelle through Yui; noon panel in Live Events 1

notes: Posters provide starts, not durations, prices, appointment lengths, virtual/in-person formats or session-specific recording permissions.
